integrity_notes: The algebraic proof establishes the infinite all-size statement; exact rational tests are finite corroboration only. No human or independent audit has been performed.
limitations: No claim for zero dephasing, position-basis decoherence, arbitrary graphs, other measurement schemes, or uniform convergence times.
The universal spectral mixing formula and small three-vertex path cases are prior results.
An earlier implicit derivation of the family-specific evaluation has not been ruled out.
scientific_scope: Combinatorial-Laplacian continuous-time quantum walks on all finite complete bipartite graphs, one localized initial site, strictly positive energy-basis dephasing, sequential position measurement; first the long-time limit, then a fixed-part graph-size limit.
title: Nonvanishing temporal nonclassicality on expanding complete bipartite quantum walks
